title: Gold Heads for the Best Week Since 2011 as `Fear Is in Control'
主要内容: Gold prices surged to their highest level in a year as investors fled a bear market in global stocks, a weakening dollar, and the fallout from the spread of negative interest rates. Futures in the metal posted the biggest weekly jump in seven years, even as prices fell on Friday. A measure of gold mining shares was poised for the highest close since July. Gold is up 44 percent and is the top performer on the Standard & Poor’s 500 Index of equities.
